description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 30.01.2017 to 05.02.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to the establishment of new exchange rates for customs duties and charges, which is a regulatory matter under the Customs Ordinance. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to determine financial regulations and rescinds previous legal notices, fitting squarely within the "Legal/Regulatory" classification for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
